dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't know you liked them so much.

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: It's not just them — all animals fascinate me! I suppose that it's an occupational hazard, though. After all, King Deshret's Seven Pillars are all animal-associated one way or the other, right?

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: As I read these books, I slowly developed a deep interest in animals...

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: The Goat King, Crocodile King, Ibis King... Large animals all! And their heads...

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: Animals just have such adorable heads!
